summary: Iteration 7 full-stack testing: strike-attribution on /api/signals/velocity + signal_history hygiene. Backend 13/13 iter-7 tests pass; full regression 51/54 (3 pre-existing failures, none iter-7 regressions). Frontend velocity chart renders 6 series with strike-count badges (◎ 4 / ◎ 2), 32 SVG circles, range toggles work without JS errors, and legend toggle correctly hides line + strike rings (circles drop 32→19).

minor.issue: Spec says on_startup must call purge_synthetic() + snapshot_all_signals(source='boot'), but neither is invoked. Only scheduled_scrape_job calls snapshot. Functional impact today is zero (synthetic_count=0 already, history grows on every ingest), but a fresh DB will boot with 0 history rows until first scheduled scrape (12h later) or first manual scrape — chart would show 'no data in window'.
Pre-existing test asserts ≥0 points per signal; with synthetic backfill removed in iter-7 only ~7 real points exist. Test is stale relative to iter-7 design and should be relaxed or removed.
Pre-existing flaky surge-detection tests fail because DB state has already been bumped by previous runs (signal counts above surge threshold). Unrelated to iter-7.

action_items: Add on_startup calls to purge_synthetic(db) and snapshot_all_signals(db, source='boot') in server.py to match iter-7 spec. Currently the imports exist but the calls are absent.
Optional: update tests/test_velocity_and_spec.py::test_default_window minimum points to reflect post-synthetic reality (e.g. ≥1 instead of ≥30).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py on_startup is missing the iter-7 mandated boot-time history bootstrap: imports for purge_synthetic and snapshot_all_signals exist (lines 30-36) but are never invoked. Add `await purge_synthetic(db)` and `await snapshot_all_signals(db, source='boot')` inside on_startup.
history.py signal_history docs lack an `id` field (only signal_id + captured_at + source). Consider adding a UUID for de-duplication and future updates.
SignalVelocityChart.jsx ReferenceDot uses ifOverflow='extendDomain' which can subtly shift xDomain when strikes fall outside [now-hours, now]. Visual behaviour is acceptable but worth noting.
seed_data_creation: test_ingest_grows_history_and_emits_strike_in_velocity POSTs the MBB sample HTML; adds 1 history row + may add 1 strike alert.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter-7 acceptance criteria all verified at runtime: (1) /api/signals/velocity returns per-series strikes array with {alert_id, t, v, prev_count, delta_pct, tier} and tier thresholds (<50 strike / 50-99 surge / ≥100 breakout) match spec; (2) signal_history has 0 synthetic rows; (3) ingest grows signal_history by ≥1 row; (4) ids= filter respected with strikes attached; (5) UI legend shows ◎ N badges for MBB (4) and MBA Kickoff (2); legend toggle hides both line and strike rings (circle count 32→19). Only spec-deviation: on_startup does not call purge_synthetic + snapshot_all_signals — see action_items.
rca of the issue: server.py imports purge_synthetic and snapshot_all_signals at lines 30-36 but on_startup (lines 597-630) only does seed_signals + scheduler.add_job. The scheduled_scrape_job correctly calls snapshot_all_signals(source='schedule'), so post-scrape snapshots work — but a freshly-booted DB will have empty history until either a manual /api/scraper/run is fired or 12h elapse. Fix: append two `await` lines to on_startup right after the seed block.
